test_title: RRB NTPC - UG 2025 (CBT 1) Mid-Range Full Test - 04
subject: general
question: In a class of 80 students (boys and girls) there are 60% girls. The average weight of the boys is 58 kg and that of the girls is 52 kg. What is the average weight (in kg) of the whole class?
solution:
**Given:**

Total students = 80

60% are girls

The average weight of boys is 58 kg and the average weight of girls is 52 kg.

**Concept Used:**

Average weight = (Sum of the weight of all the students/Total no. of students)

**Calculation:**

Number of girls = 80 × (60/100) = 48

Number of boys = (80 - 48) = 32

Now average weight of whole class = ((32 × 58) + (48 × 52))/80 = 4352/80 = 54.4

**∴ The average weight (in kg) of the whole class will be 54.4.**
